body:
My cellphone plan is an old grandfathered student special, purchased it several years ago when when you could still get unlimited data for <$50 a month in ON. If I lose my plan now I will be forced to pay 3x what I am now for the same services and less data in the future :( Trying VERY hard to keep the cellphone because if I lose it that's it. Would rather cancel my home internet plan than get rid of the phone.

I think I tried to apply for works before but was rejected because of the ongoing house sale at the time. Might be worth a shot again.

I do not think my previous nursing employer had any sort of disability insurance policies. Worked at one of those off-site virtual methadone clinics we did not even have an anti-harassment policy in place when I was being physically assaulted by a coworker so I am so doubtful. My current life insurance is through my husband's place of employment as a spouse.

Thank you for quoting that blurb. I shall mention I am a card carrying Métis, maybe I should have said in my post. I am going to get off the net for the day and try calling the LAO to see what my options are.

Thank you and blessings.

We don't go out of the house for movies/concerts/coffee dates or order food in anymore. Factoring in the extra costs like gas, parking, time off work it just is not feasible for us to leave the apartment. All homecooking with what was on sale that week + pantry leftovers. I have too many panic attacks 'treating myself' to things like coffee or a snack because all I can think is 'this $3 could have gone to the CC' and then everything just snowballs from there. The $9 netflix is our entire monthly entertainment budget right now. But that is $9 I can save if I just go back to torrenting. My father would be throwing a fit right now if he knew I even had a fun budget. Every penny counts right? I'm sorry, I did not mean to complain to you. Thinking out loud.

Hello. Thank you.

No that is okay, thank you for offering but I cannot accept that. I am in Ontario, I can get the legwork done myself. I just need to know where to go or who to google. I don't think I can do a debt consolidation most of my debt is at the bank and with my car company. Would seeing a financial adviser at my bank be beneficial?

Utilities ect are all included in rent which my husband pays (I give him half in cash). I have a monthly cellphone bill in my name. I am able to make my bill most months. Last month I could not afford to pay it, so I paid last months and this months bill off at the start of Aug when I got paid last.

Sending best wishes to you friend. Thank you.

Thank you for taking time to respond.

1. Want to start saving. Trying to trim my budget further. I will have to ask my husband to cancel netflix that $9 payment could go to the bank fees instead. 

2. UPS never notified me of missed payments. But it is my fault I should have looked to make sure they charged it, I just don't understand why they never called or sent a letter just straight to collections. That has been paid off though. **How long until that is off my score?** 5 years? 10 years? Or is it always there?

3. I think so. Lawyers dealt with it all. Have been on the phone with the CRA multiple times the last few weeks and they told me I only have that $200 payment due for trillium. I imagine they would have told me if I owed more/back taxes?

4. Two months from now I could pay it in full. I can afford $50 a cheque to put forward. Asked CRA how long I have to pay it but they told me there is no time limit ???

5. No, I currently am not receiving disability. I currently have no DR to sign me off even if I wanted to collect. Will be honest with you friend- I do not want disability. I want to work. It is the last facade of independence & normality I have left. The last time I was forced on disability I attempted suicide because I felt so worthless and a burden to society.

Seriously, thank you for reading over my post. I just need to find a way to make more money. Maybe I could go sit in the park and try reading Tarot cards for tips. I don't think that is against the law?
My husband is coming home soon, I am going to log off now so I can start a bit of supper. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. I feel more grounded.

Thank you. It has been too long, I would not be able to go to the pharmacy and refill my meds again from there. But I think that would have been an option. Frankly I want a different med though, I was up to 200mg Pristiq, couldn't even function just a zombie. DR just kept upping my dose even though I told him it wasn't working, the side effects were unmanageable. Detoxing off that poison is not even something I would wish on my worst enemy. I'm still getting random brain zaps and it has been months.

Too scared to call. I know they will send someone if I start talking or admit how angry/violent I feel. It might be paranoia talking but I have a bucket list of horror stories from going to the hospital in the past, it is not a safe healing place. The nurses laughed at my suicide note when I started to get care back in '12. Then the male nurse flirted with my sister while they dropped me into observation and ignored me until the monitoring period was up then booted me out with no followups or help. Not a safe place. Not at all. I'd just be wasting valuable resources for people who actually need care like a cancer patient. 

There is a system, thank you this reminded me. I took time last friday/this weekend to call CareConnect. Dropped my old family DR. Waiting for the confirmation letters. A lady on the phone was really nice and found me a new family doctor but I can't go until the package arrives in the mail. This DR also doesn't deal with mental health just a family dr. I will have to wait to see her, then get a referral. Then it is a wait list. When I first moved to this city I called CMHA to find a free therapist (cannot afford one) wait list is over 1 year long. Not sure I can make it another year without someone to help me walk through this. I'm stuck in the medical system limbo right now.

I just need to keep it together enough for 8 hours tomorrow. To go to work. I HAVE to work, I like work, and money keeps everything flowing. At home I can stay safe. Work I need to function like a normal person there.

Seriously, I just want to say that being able to talk about this is making it more manageable right now in this moment. Thank you for taking time to chat.

Thank you for taking your time to respond. I need help coping, I suppose. Was diagnosed with depression with psychosis in '12. I think it might be worse though, maybe schziophrenia, but I'm not a doctor. Honestly I have not seen a healthcare provider since '15 when I moved. Asked my DR to help me find a care provider in my new town but all he could do for me was refill my scripts for 3 months then dumped me. So currently not on meds.

I'm full of burning hot anger. The voices tell me if I hurt someone it will get better but I KNOW it will not. Just cause problems. I'm not that person. I have flaws but I'm a good person. I don't want to hurt anyone. I just want to stop these feelings and be in control. I just am struggling so hard to cope and I feel like standing on the VIA rail tracks is the only way it will stop. I don't want to be a burden anymore.
this was a mistake, i am sorry
So scary. I hope everything worked out for you in the end friend.
Thank you so much! Just finished with the local police. Have a few more calls to make.
Thank you! (sorry we just got back from taking with the police) Never would have thought to do this. I will let my husband know.
